question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or keep heartbeat model routing at the whole-turn/plugin or cron-job level?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but any fix adds public syntax and model/session precedence rather than repairing a broken existing behavior contract.

options.title: Keep routing plugin- or job-owned
options.body: Document that HEARTBEAT.md tasks share one heartbeat model today and route finer-grained scheduled model choices through plugin hooks or the open cron/job-level override track.

options.title: Add native task model hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields in HEARTBEAT.md tasks, split due tasks by effective model, and add docs/tests for precedence, timestamps, and session restoration.

options.title: Fold into cron model override design
options.body: Treat this as a heartbeat-specific overlap of the scheduled-job model override work and decide both contracts together.

recommendation.title: Keep routing plugin- or job-owned
recommendation.body: Document that HEARTBEAT.md tasks share one heartbeat model today and route finer-grained scheduled model choices through plugin hooks or the open cron/job-level override track.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a core-vs-plugin/product-surface decision around the existing model-routing hook seam.
